goal:
T69 — home workspace on / (owner's page vision: feature tabs at the far left [FeatureRail, already there], AI status
on the left of the main area, the implementation on the right, the input at the bottom; you type and watch the
result evolve live). Web only.
1. apps/web/lib/arenaStatus.ts: arenaAgentPanel(doc, side) -> exactly four rows builder, critic, runner, gate:
   {role, state, message} from that lane's recorded events (doc.lanes[side].events [{seq, role, message}]): message =
   the role's newest event; state "active" only when the arena is running, that lane is not finished (status not
   succeeded/failed) and the role's newest event is the lane's newest event; "done" otherwise; "idle" with message null
   when the role has no event (null doc -> four idle rows). Never invent activity.
2. apps/web/app/[locale]/page.tsx becomes the workspace:
   - main area left (~1/3): AI status for the latest arena (GET /v1/arena newest first; prefer a prompt arena), one
     column per side (EvoForge, single AI) rendering arenaAgentPanel rows with active/done/idle dots, plus that arena's
     prompt and verdict;
   - main area right (~2/3, the widest): the implementation — both sides' SandboxedPreview of the latest arena (use
     previewView from arenaStatus), with scores and a link to /arena for the full view and to /replay;
   - bottom: the PromptBar (as on /arena; after a start, show the new arena here and poll while it runs);
   - keep every existing Mission Control feature (metrics, missions, proof card, SSE EventSource with polling
     fallback, outcomes, participants...) but move it into a collapsible section (<details> or a button with
     aria-expanded) below the workspace; do not delete behaviour.
   Mobile (<768px): stack AI status above the implementation; the bar stays at the bottom.
3. i18n (en + ko) for new labels.
Keep tsc green and every web-structure test green (many tests read page.tsx; keep what they check).
